name: std::ios_base::openmode

declarations.code: static constexpr openmode noreplace = /* implementation defined */;

intro:
Specifies available file open flags. It is a BitmaskType, the following constants are defined:

Constant

 Explanation




 app

 seek to the end of stream before each write




 binary

 open in binary mode




 in

 open for reading




 out

 open for writing




 trunc

 discard the contents of the stream when opening




 ate

 seek to the end of stream immediately after open




 noreplace (C++23)

 open in exclusive mode
